commits.subject: Record the r4 boundary state: AJC.rr gap 1 closed, gap 2 untouched, and two durable method findings
commits.summary:
**Roadmap.** AJC.rr and AJC.rr.degvanish carry a delta saying single-field vanishing is no longer conditional -- the curve-level endpoints carry three curve binders with pi constructed and both finiteness binders synthesised -- while stating explicitly that extension-uniformity is UNTOUCHED and the rows stay done because the SUBSTRATE was their target, not uniformity. Also records the corrected port-cost figures (59 -> 21 -> 4).

**Two memory items.** I-0678: price a port by declaration reference, not import closure, since a Lean file bundles a construction with its class-side theory; carries its own correction after a ground review re-measured my figures. I-0679: a hypothesis can be SATISFIABLE yet witnessed nowhere in the project -- a third failure mode beside FALSE and VACUOUS, invisible to sorry counts, axiom probes and green builds, which is what DegreeVanishing.lean was and what this session closed.

commits.subject: STATE THE SCRATCH-PATH CAVEAT ON MY OWN 42 CLEAN LINES: all eight modules are outside the root cone
commits.summary:
**The limit on every line this probe prints.** Measured 2026-07-29 by walking import AlgebraicJacobian from the root module: 257 of 274 modules are in the root cone, and all eight of this layer are among the 17 that are not. They are committed, so past the grace period -- lake build AlgebraicJacobian does not elaborate them and no #print axioms line THROUGH THE ROOT can reach them. The 42 clean lines are real, kernel-checked and reproducible by running this file, but they are scratch-path, not certified by the root build.

**Also fixed the control name in the header**, which still said probe_control_leaky from an earlier draft while the actual control is Scheme.fgaPicardRepresentability. A caution section that misnames its own control is the kind of defect this file exists to catch. Rooting the eight modules is one import line in AlgebraicJacobian.lean, outside this task write scope; tracked as I-0600 and disclosed in README.md.

commits.subject: THREE REVIEW CORRECTIONS AGAINST ME: a phantom declaration name, and the Picard cone is FOURTEEN not twelve
commits.summary:
**A phantom declaration name in a landed docstring.** FiberBound.lean:53 cited generated_unconditional_of_isFinite_toP1, which exists nowhere in the workspace -- the theorem is exists_bound_generated_of_isFinite_toP1, named correctly twelve lines below. Same failure mode I have now committed twice, and it survived my own reading because the correct name appears nearby.

**The Picard cone is FOURTEEN modules and the absent set is 21, not 23.** Re-measured myself rather than accept either figure: the closure is 59, of which 21 are absent when a module counts as present if EITHER its own path or Ledger/<basename>.lean exists -- 14 Picard plus Challenge plus RiemannRoch.Degree plus the 5 files that ARE the port. My 23 predated the Ledger-basename fallback; the reviewer count reproduces and mine does not.

**What the review CONFIRMED independently, over all 55 modules of my closure with comments stripped:** picClass, CechPic, classDeg, divisorClass, PresentationDivisor, fiberTwist, fiberCocycle occur ZERO times in code. Zero Picard modules and no Challenge in the closure. Also confirmed: the three-binder signature, and NON-VACUITY by instantiating both curve theorems at the concrete Adelic.p1Over k with every binder synthesised. Rebuilt, exit 0.

commits.subject: SPLIT extension-uniformity into the free half and the open half, and prove the free half
commits.summary:
**The free half, now a theorem.** All three curve binders of exists_bound_subsingleton_hModule_one_curve are stable under base change along a field extension: properness and smoothness of relative dimension one by their mathlib IsStableUnderBaseChange instances, and GeometricallyIrreducible likewise (checked directly against mathlib, not assumed). So the vanishing theorem RE-FIRES at C_kappa for every kappa, with a threshold per field and no new mathematics. baseChange_binders_stable records it.

**The open half, stated precisely.** What blocks uniformity is not the binders but that the per-field thresholds are produced independently: b(kappa) = deg(n0(kappa) F) + 1 - chi, where n0(kappa) is a Classical.choose on a Noetherian stabilization re-run from scratch at each base field, and nothing relates n0(kappa) to n0(k). Same obstruction AJCR names on its own carrier -- windowM_choice is a Nat.find per field (WindowLedger.lean:186), which is exactly why WindowFieldTransport moves vanishing FACTS one field at a time rather than the constant.

**Why the split matters.** The honest residue is NOT "vanishing over extensions is unavailable" -- it is "the constant does not transport". Those call for different next steps, and conflating them is how the gap gets mispriced. The two named inputs that would fix it are unchanged: flat base change for the section spaces, and a WeilDivisor pullback along C_kappa to C. With those, b(k) itself would serve; without them, re-firing the theorem produces no uniform bound. Kernel-checked, 8612 jobs, exit 0.

commits.subject: S6b: the hypothesis pair is no longer the project's best vanishing statement, and name the THIRD failure mode
commits.summary:
**Docstring only; the file still runs, exit 0.** Section 6b of this file is my own from r3 and described single-field vanishing as carrying a hypothesis pair (base vanishing at one divisor plus peel-surjectivity). That still describes the ADELIC carrier faithfully and the table rows are untouched -- but an independent route on the LEDGER carrier now closes it with no hypothesis of either kind, and a caution section that omits that is misleading in the direction it exists to prevent.

**The third failure mode, named where it belongs.** Section 8 lists FALSE and VACUOUS. DegreeVanishing.lean was neither: its named hypothesis was SATISFIABLE but witnessed at no proper curve in this project -- and a sorry count, a clean axiom line and a green build all report that as healthy. Recorded as a distinct mode, alongside the contrast that FiberBound leaves no instance binder and no named hypothesis for a consumer to fail to discharge. Extension-uniformity is stated to be unaffected: every constant in the new layer is over the single field K.

commits.subject: Retract my own port-cost overestimate WHERE IT LIVES: 59 closure modules was an import count, not a dependency count
commits.summary:
**Docstring only, code byte-identical, rebuilt (8581 jobs, exit 0).** Three sites in this file were stale the moment FiberVanishing/FiberBound landed. (1) The antecedent is no longer unwitnessed: the paragraph saying AJC proves it at no proper curve is now marked HISTORY and points at exists_bound_subsingleton_hModule_one_curve, which carries three curve binders and no vanishing hypothesis. (2) "until it lands, every star fires only under a hypothesis AJC cannot supply" -- it landed. (3) The genus-zero specialisation no longer needs to send readers to an unported theorem.

**The retraction that is worth more than the fix.** This file priced the port at 59 closure modules with an unavoidable Picard-presentation dependency, "~2.5k lines and a Picard dependency", and told the reader not to re-guess it. That number counted IMPORT LINES. By DECLARATION REFERENCE the vanishing chain uses picClass, CechPic, divisorClass and classDeg zero times; the twelve Picard modules hung off class-side material the argument never mentions, and the single edge that carried anything real was carrying the coeffAt calculus. Corrected in place, with the general lesson stated: an import closure is an upper bound and can overstate tenfold when a file bundles a construction with its class theory.

commits.subject: 41/41 axiom-clean with the control FIRING, measured at a curve where nothing is left for a caller to instantiate
commits.summary:
**Measured, not asserted.** 41 declarations of the fibrewise-vanishing layer report [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; zero sorryAx. The control (Scheme.fgaPicardRepresentability, the standing open FGA obligation) reports sorryAx, so the probe is calibrated -- per I-0661 a clean line means nothing if a stale olean has silenced the control.

**Where it is measured matters.** The two lines that count are exists_bound_subsingleton_hModule_one_curve and exists_bound_h0_eq_genus_curve, plus probe_curve_consumer which elaborates a CONSUMER of the second. At those sites the finite dominant pi is CONSTRUCTED by exists_isFinite_isDominant_toP1 and both Module.Finite cohomology binders are SYNTHESISED by ChiCurve -- so no instance binder is left for a caller to fail to instantiate. This is the axiom-frontier trap-(d) check, and the layer passes it: unlike DegreeVanishing.lean, whose clean lines sat above an antecedent AJC witnessed at no proper curve.

commits.subject: THE CONDITIONAL LAYER IS DISCHARGED: all four cluster-P statements now depend only on (Y, pi)
commits.summary:
**What changed.** DegreeVanishing.lean proved bounded H1 vanishing, exact Riemann-Roch, the exact section drop and global generation, each conditional on ONE base vanishing at ONE divisor -- an antecedent my r3 measured as witnessed at NO proper curve in AJC. FiberVanishing supplies that base at D0 = n0 F for the fiber divisor of a finite dominant pi, so all four are now stated with NO vanishing hypothesis: exists_bound_subsingleton_hModule_one_of_isFinite_toP1, exists_bound_h0_eq_of_isFinite_toP1, exists_bound_section_drop_of_isFinite_toP1, exists_bound_generated_of_isFinite_toP1.

**Why the bound is uniform in D.** The fiber vanishing gives a PER-D tower threshold. Instantiating it at the fixed divisor 0 fixes one D0 = n0 F depending only on (Y, pi), BEFORE any D is seen; the degree slack is then carried by the linear-equivalence translate manufactured inside exists_le_subsingleton_of_deg_ge, not by growing the twist. That quantifier order is what turns a per-D tower bound into a degree half-space uniform in D.

**Still open, stated in the file.** Extension-uniformity is UNTOUCHED. Every constant here -- n0, b, deg, chi -- lives over the single field K, and n0 comes from a Classical.choose on a Noetherian stabilization re-run from scratch at each base field. Nothing in AJC or AJCR closes it. Global generation is closed here but by an INDEPENDENT route (the devissage slice), not as a corollary of vanishing. Kernel-checked, 8601 jobs, exit 0, zero sorries.

commits.subject: H1(O(D + nF)) VANISHES FOR LARGE n IN AJC -- the antecedent my r3 measured as unwitnessed
commits.summary:
**The theorem.** For a finite dominant pi : Y -> P1 and any Weil divisor D, H1(O(D + n F)) is subsingleton for all large n. Route: the two-cover Cech H1 of the twisted sheaf is N / A_n for the FIXED ambient N = O(D)(V0 inf V1), the ladder A_n increases and exhausts N, and N/A_0 is finite-dimensional by the devissage -- so Noetherian stabilization forces A_n = top eventually. Per-D n0, no duality, no R^1 f_*.

**What it closes.** My r3 landed DegreeVanishing.lean conditional on Subsingleton H1(O_X) and then measured that AJC witnesses that antecedent at NO proper curve -- the sole producer carried [IsAffine X], which a proper curve never satisfies. This supplies a base vanishing on a real curve bundle, so that conditional layer stops resting on something the project cannot produce.

**Scope, stated in the file.** This is SINGLE-FIELD vanishing in the twist direction of one pi. It is NOT extension-uniformity (nothing in either project has that; the AJCR analogue transports facts one field at a time because the ledger constants are per-field Classical.choose values) and NOT global generation (proved separately off the devissage slice). The module docstring separates the three explicitly.

**Provenance.** AJCR RiemannRoch/FLVVanishing.lean, bodies unchanged; the mathematics is AJCRs, argument and all. AJCs contribution is the carrier substitution that removes the Picard cone. Kernel-checked, 8597 jobs, exit 0, zero style warnings, zero sorries.

commits.subject: THE PICARD CONE WAS BUNDLING, NOT DEPENDENCY -- now checked, not argued: divisor sheaves are QcohOn
commits.summary:
**The discharge.** Every divisor sheaf O(D) satisfies the quasi-coherence packaging QcohOn on every open: an ambient section acts by its germ at the generic point (preserving pole bounds), denominators clear because div(germ g) is finitely supported, and defect annihilation is degenerate since restrictions between nonempty opens are injective. Hence twisted affine Serre vanishing fires: Subsingleton H1(U, O(D)) for affine U -- the two instances the two-cover H1 carrier consumes at the chart preimages.

**The audit claim is now empirical.** AJCR imports FLVQcoh against Picard/PresentationDivisor.lean, the single entry point of its twelve-module Picard cone into the vanishing chain. I predicted from declaration counts that the edge was needed only for the coeffAt calculus. Substituting Ledger/FiberDivisor.lean for it, the file elaborates and kernel-checks with NO other change -- no picClass, no CechPic, no meromorphic presentation. The prediction is confirmed rather than asserted.

commits.subject: Twisted affine Serre vanishing for a quasi-coherence PACKAGING, not just the structure sheaf
commits.summary:
**The generalisation AJC lacked.** AJC proved degree-one affine vanishing only for the structure sheaf (Ledger/AffineVanishing.lean). These two files carry the class Scheme.QcohOn -- a sheaf of k-modules with an ambient-section action, denominator clearing, and defect annihilation -- and prove subsingleton_hModule_one_of_qcoh for ANY sheaf satisfying it. The structure-sheaf statement is recovered as an instance, so nothing is duplicated.

**Mechanical port.** AJCR Cohomology/QcohSections.lean and Cohomology/AffineVanishingQcoh.lean, bodies byte-identical, only the import paths rewritten to the Ledger namespace -- both their bases (ModuleKSheaf, AffineCech, AffineVanishing) are already byte-identical Ledger ports. This is the layer that discharges the two affine-vanishing instances the two-cover H1 carrier consumes. Kernel-checked.

commits.subject: The twist ladder EXHAUSTS the overlap lattice: pole clearing at the fiber over [1:0]
commits.summary:
**The geometric heart.** Over V1 and over the overlap the section lattice of O(D + n F) is UNCHANGED, since F is supported off V1. Over V0 it is u^{-n} times O(D)(V0), growing with n by the mulByUnit mechanism at section level. So the Cech H1 denominators form an increasing ladder inside the FIXED ambient N = O(D)(V0 inf V1), and iSup_fiberLattice proves the ladder fills N by pole clearing at the fiber over [1:0].

**Provenance and one adaptation.** AJCR RiemannRoch/FLVLattice.lean, bodies unchanged. AJCR imports Cohomology/AffineVanishingQcoh.lean, which AJC lacks; nothing in the lattice statements needs it, so the edge is dropped rather than made to wait on a QcohOn port. Kernel-checked, 8591 jobs, exit 0.

commits.subject: The fiber Weil divisor F = (div u)+ and its order table, with the coeffAt calculus AJC was missing
commits.summary:
**The fiber unit.** The pulled-back chart-0 coordinate has a germ at the generic point that is a UNIT of K(Y), its inverse being the chart-1 coordinate. Its principal divisor is nonnegative on V0, nonpositive on V1, and at least 1 at every point of V0 minus V1 -- the fiber over [1:0]. F is its positive part: effective, supported on that fiber, of positive degree given a fiber witness.

**Extracted, not imported.** AJC had coeffAt but none of its calculus. In AJCR those lemmas share Picard/PresentationDivisor.lean with the meromorphic-presentation bridge, and that edge is what pulls the Picard cone into the FLV closure. The calculus half is pure Finsupp bookkeeping with zero Picard content, so it is ported here rather than taken by import. Bodies unchanged; kernel-checked, 8588 jobs, exit 0.

commits.subject: The FLV cover half is Picard-free: fiber chart and coordinate, and the twelve-file Picard cone is NOT load-bearing
commits.summary:
**Ported.** AJCR RiemannRoch/FiberTwist.lean section Cover plus its three regularity lemmas, bodies unchanged, as Ledger/FiberChart.lean. The overlap of the two chart preimages is Y.basicOpen t0 for the pulled-back coordinate, and the generic point lies in it when pi is dominant.

**Audit finding.** AJCR FLVVanishing has a 59-module import closure with 23 modules missing from AJC, including twelve Picard.* presentation modules and AlgebraicJacobian.Challenge. Measured by declaration reference rather than by import line, the vanishing chain uses NONE of them; the Picard cone is dragged in only by the class-side fiberDivisor/fiberTwist/classDeg, which the vanishing argument never mentions.
